<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-param "<!ENTITY ent-val 'Parameter Expanded'>">
  %ent-param;
  <!ENTITY ent-general "General &ent-val;">

  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment containing pseudo-markup <child>test</child> -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with entities &ent-general; and tags <foo>bar</foo> ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent-general;</child>
</root>

<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Second &ent1;">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY pe-ent 'Parameter Entity Value'>">

]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://www.w3.org/default" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment 1: Testing multiple comments and PIs -->
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
  <!-- Comment 2: Inside catalog -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA section with &ent2; and %pe-ent; references inside text.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&ent2; and %pe-ent;</item>
</catalog>

  <meta:info>

    <![CDATA[

        Secure CDATA block enclosing XML-like syntax: &e-derived;
      </digsig:signature>
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <record>&local-macro; - &e-derived;</record>
</archive>

  <!ENTITY % entity-macro "<!ENTITY macro-val 'Expanded Macro'>">
  %entity-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="library.css"?>
<library xmlns="http://library.org/ns" xmlns:lib="http://library.org/ns/lib" xmlns:auth="http://library.org/ns/auth">
  <!-- Library collection comment explaining namespaces -->
  <auth:book>
    <![CDATA[
      <book-content>
        CDATA with &book-ref; and &macro-val;
      </book-content>
    ]]>
  </auth:book>
  <lib:book>&book-ref; - &macro-val;</lib:book>
</library>
